items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was in a sextet with the Yusef, see.

ctx.x: ...was in the band then. 'Cause Yusef {Lateef} had left. But we had a helluva band man, this band was like,
man, this was one of the badd st sextets you ever wanna hear. Cause we had some helluva music in there, man. We used to, we used, I've seen people jump up from the table, man, you know.
